lines.en: Where is my toothbrush? I can't find it.
lines.ko: 내 칫솔 어디 있어요? 못 찾겠어요.

lines.en: It's by the mirror, next to the soap.
Thanks. And where is my towel?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 그리고 내 수건은 어디 있어요?

lines.en: I washed all the towels this morning.
So what will I use today?
Use the blue one. It's dry now.
lines.ko: 파란 걸 써요. 지금은 말라 있어요.

lines.en: Great. I will wash my hair now.
Please dry the floor after your shower.
I will. Can you bring the comb?
Here it is. Have a nice day!
Let's wash our hands before lunch.
Grandma, can I use the pink soap?
Yes. Wash them well in the bathroom.
How long do I wash them?
Sing the song two times. That's enough.
lines.ko: 노래를 두 번 불러요. 그러면 충분해요.

lines.en: Look in the mirror! My hands are white!
Good job. Now dry them with the towel.
Yesterday I forgot to wash my hands.
Will you wash them with me every day?
Yes, Grandma! I will wash them every day.
